name: spec-builder
description: Write a spec — problem, done-when clauses, steps, how done-ness is decided — then compile it into a workflow definition PersonalClaw's own workflow engine runs. This app is a front over that engine, not a second planner: it emits definitions and never executes one, so there is no parallel scheduler, run journal or retry policy to keep in step.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Source repository
x-meta.help: The git repository a spec is about. spec_seed reads one file out of it at a named revision (read-only, via `git show`) so a spec can be grounded in the code rather than in a guess. Empty leaves spec_seed unavailable — there is deliberately no default, because an app that guesses which checkout to read is an app that reads the wrong one.

x-meta.label: git Timeout
x-meta.help: Maximum seconds to wait for a `git` command before giving up.
